_comment: Provider overrides for Mira, loaded via MIRA_PROVIDERS_JSON_PATH. Profiles are matched by exact base_url. Mira bundles only an 'openrouter' profile, so without this override every request to OpenCode Go (Zen) fails with HTTP 400 MissingSessionID — Zen requires an x-opencode-session header on every chat-completions request. The CI workflow generates its own copy with a per-PR session id (better prompt-cache routing); this file is for local runs. See https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it
